summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching four Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns dated Oct 28, 29, 30 and Nov 2, 2026, disclosing routine share repurchases and treasury-share movements. The first return shows 43,420 ordinary shares repurchased on Oct 27 as treasury shares at USD 22.816 per share, 0.0014% of issued shares, lifting treasury holdings to 10,446,925. Remaining exhibits cover comparable small daily buyback and authorized-share updates. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date is stated; buybacks run under the existing mandate. Watch aggregate repurchase pace and any acceleration toward a formal capital-return program.
